scope: two-action public fixed-duel policy only; full G2/G3 open
law: For two legal actions: d = logit0-logit1; rare_action = 1 if d>=0 else 0; r = max(2^-24, sigmoid(-abs(d))) in FP32. Exact masses are r and the real complement 1-r. At equal logits action1 is designated rare but both masses are 1/2.
logs: rare log(r), common log1p(-r), FP32; illegal/terminal finite sentinel zero. Returned probabilities are FP32 renderings, not the authority for complements.
sampling: Fold each supplied Threefry key with 0x44594231; draw two uint32 words in high/low order; choose rare iff concatenated word < r*2^64. Compute the integer threshold from FP32 exponent/mantissa; no FP64 or uniform float is used. Exact mass claims are conditional on uniformly distributed word pairs.
gradient: Standard FP32 autodiff through clipped sigmoid and log/log1p. Floor is constant with zero derivative at and below floor; at equal logits use the d>=0 branch. No straight-through integer quantizer. The integer sampler is outside the loss gradient.
mask: One legal action has mass one, logp zero, entropy and policy gradient zero. No legal actions means terminal padding: action -1, probabilities/logs/value zero.
compatibility: No old trajectory/old_logp/checkpoint reuse. New checkpoint format and source/contract binding. Existing simulator chance sampler remains nominal 1/24 and is not Showdown finite-word equivalent.
limits: A short numerical qualification, not a new two-hour soak, strength evaluation, hidden-set coverage or expanded mechanics gate. Final reserved teams stay untouched. Prime unnecessary.
